build_pooler_layer: build a Pooler layer that applies a linear transform and tanh activation to hidden states
create_itm_head: create an ITMHead that maps hidden states to a 2-class image-text matching output
build_mlm_head: build an MLMHead with a BERT transform and decoder for masked language modeling predictions
review_pooler_forward: review the Pooler forward pass that transforms hidden states through dense and tanh layers
test_mlm_head_weight_init: test the MLMHead initialization that optionally reuses a pre-trained embedding weight matrix
